name: com.lingkyn.live-tuning.unity
description: Thin Unity adapter for the Lingkyn Live Tuning Core: explicit target resolution from Core binding records through hand-written, per-asset-type binders with fail-closed diagnostics; a plain runtime constructed with explicit references that applies every accepted tuning intent to the bound skin instance and re-invokes the renderer adapter's own skin entry point; an injectable ITuningExportSink with a device-side JSON writer under the persistent data path and an Editor-only writer into a bound override asset; explicit import of a device override file; exactly one editor implementation per EditorKind; and a tuning panel host that is a client of an ITuningPanelSurface seam, with a minimal UGUI fallback surface until the XR UI shell's own panel surface exists.
